opening.argument: Several signals deserve scrutiny when considered together: an on-screen “REWARDS” display, an “upcoming giveaway,” and a request to subscribe, enable notifications, and like/share. These are not details needed to evaluate a phone's processor, display, battery, or cameras. They introduce a benefit-oriented hook and an action-oriented audience funnel without supplying eligibility, timing, or fulfillment details in the provided description. Even if the handset review is genuine, the reward component can still make the surrounding content a solicitation whose material terms are left unclear.
